'''Jed Humphreys''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Buford tournament]] on 9 June 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Zafar Tejani's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2445">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-z-goes-to-gq-buford-june-9-2001d2445/ z-goes-to-gq-buford-june-9-2001], DeckTech (Zafar "Zmanthe1st" Tejani, 12 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-z-goes-to-gq-buford-june-9-2001d2445/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
